description: [40 or 311 credits] One AI still (40 credits each) or clip (house 311, a named model its list_models price) straight into your bank — no render. A still takes model, aspect_ratio, count, negative_prompt, no_faces, character, objects; the rest are clip controls. 6 calls a minute. Clip controls are refused, with the allowed values, when the model is not sent them; model auto picks one and says why. best_of makes N and keeps the best graded (all N charged). Charged before, refunded on failure; dry_run quotes it free. Paid plans. A 5 s clip takes about 4–5 min (house, seedance-2.0-mini 720p), about 8–10 min on minimax-h3 2K: the call answers generating within 20 s with job_id and expected_s; follow it with get_asset_job, or call again with the SAME idempotency_key (or arguments) after retry_after_seconds, never charged twice.

best_of.description: N graded, best kept, all charged.

callback_url.description: https URL POSTed a signed event (asset.done or asset.failed) when it ends, 3 tries; signed as create_video's callback_url.

character.description: A character from create_character, so the same face comes back.

dry_run.description: Quote only; nothing made or charged.

first_frame.description: Bank image id/URL to start on, sent uncropped: the clip takes its shape. Lettering gets redrawn (warned).

idempotency_key.description: Same key within 24 h returns what it made, uncharged. Without one, an identical call within 10 min does; one still running is reported, not restarted.

kind.description: image (a still) or video (a clip). Default image.

last_frame.description: Bank image to end on. Requires first_frame.

model.description: list_models id, house, house-image, or auto (clips; see optimize).

negative_prompt.description: Stills: an Avoid clause. Clips: where the model takes one.

no_faces.description: Stills: no face or head; people as hands.

objects.description: Object names (list_objects) kept consistent, after the character.

site_url.description: Attach it to one of your sites.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags, to find it again.

name: generate_asset

equivalents.description: model, display_name, resolution, duration_s, credits, note.

title: Generate one image or clip, without making a video
